rationale: Hand-promoted from a japicmp CLASS_REMOVED finding via the proposer artefact (skill byte-diff-catalogue.md (local) section 8.1). The fork re-implements the parser/codegen via ANTLR4 per the ROADMAP mission; Xtext tool-surface classes including this RosettaJavaPackages helper are deliberately not replicated. Status=active because no current D-entry blesses Xtext-tool-surface absence as accepted; a future fork-mandate D-entry can promote this entry (and the dozens of sibling Xtext-class entries that will accumulate as the proposer is run) to status=accepted in one batch. Sentinel our_hash marks our absence (no bytes emitted); upstream_hash uses the same sentinel rather than a real bytecode hash to avoid pinning a baseline JAR fingerprint that the next japicmp baseline rebase will invalidate.
